game.title: Pragmata
game.blurb: Sci-fi action-adventure from Capcom set on the Moon, released 2026-04-17. RAWG has no average playtime yet. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Guide Hugh and Diana through the lunar station, sector by sector.

chapters.title: Life in the Shelter
chapters.summary: Talk to Diana, swap presents and fill in stamp boards between missions.

chapters.title: Sectors and Secrets
chapters.summary: Reach full sector progress: Red Zones, Holo-Walls, Mini Cabins, escape hatches.

chapters.title: Combat, Hacking and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Weapon prints, hacking nodes, upgrades, training sims and combat feats.

chapters.title: Post-game Challenges
chapters.summary: Special sectors, side signals and the hardest difficulty.
